summary: nerolation 提交 EIP-8077 更新，为 frame 交易定义 source 和 nonce，理清它与 EIP-8141、EIP-8250 的交互，让带 nonce 宣告交易的 P2P 协议能处理原生 AA 交易。EIP-8261 从共识强制规则改为信息性的、仅 CL 配置的分叉 gas limit 时间表并合并。EIP-8363 递减发行销毁以草案合并。Protocol Guild 宣布 ACD Fund，首笔资助 nixorokish 的 ACDE 协调工作。

items.title: EIP-8077：为 frame 交易定义 source 和 nonce
items.note: （nerolation）提交，说明与 EIP-8141 和 EIP-8250 的交互。EIP-8077 是在交易宣告中附带 nonce 的 eth 协议扩展。
items.title_en: EIP-8077: define source and nonce for frame transactions
items.note_en: (nerolation), submitted, clarifying the interaction with EIP-8141 and EIP-8250. EIP-8077 is the eth protocol extension that announces transactions together with their nonce.
items.topic_en: Frame transactions and the gas limit

items.title: EIP-8261：改为信息性的 gas limit 时间表建议
items.note: （barnabasbusa）合并。不改共识、不强制执行，EIP-1559 的 ±1/1024 弹性规则仍是唯一的 gas limit 有效性规则，高于或低于时间表的区块都有效；时间表是 CL `config.yaml` 中可选的 `GAS_LIMIT_SCHEDULE` 字段，仿照 EIP-7892 的 `BLOB_SCHEDULE`。按 epoch 激活的澄清（nflaig）同日合并。
items.title_en: EIP-8261: convert to an informational gas limit schedule recommendation
items.note_en: (barnabasbusa), merged. There are no consensus changes and no enforcement; the EIP-1559 ±1/1024 elasticity rule remains the only gas limit validity rule, and blocks above or below the schedule stay valid. The schedule is an optional `GAS_LIMIT_SCHEDULE` field in the CL `config.yaml`, mirroring EIP-7892's `BLOB_SCHEDULE`. A clarification of epoch-based activation (nflaig) was merged the same day.

keywords_en: EIP-8077 source and nonce for frame transactions
EIP-8261 becomes an informational gas limit schedule
summary_en: nerolation submitted an EIP-8077 update that defines the source and nonce of frame transactions and clarifies its interaction with EIP-8141 and EIP-8250, so the P2P protocol that announces transactions with nonces can handle native AA transactions. EIP-8261 was turned from a consensus-enforced rule into an informational, CL-config-only per-fork gas limit schedule and merged. EIP-8363 tapered issuance burn was merged as a draft. Protocol Guild announced the ACD Fund, whose first allocation funds nixorokish's ACDE coordination.
